name: Diviner

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: Sees what's coming: Portent replaces rolls with foretold d20s, and divinations refund slots.

feature.name: Divination Savant
feature.summary: Add two Divination spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free.
feature.text: Choose two Wizard spells from the Divination school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one more Divination Wizard spell of a level you can cast for free.

feature.name: Portent
feature.summary: After each Long Rest, roll two d20s; replace any D20 Test you can see with one of them.
feature.text: When you finish a Long Rest, roll two d20s and record them. You can replace any D20 Test made by you or a creature you can see with one of these rolls, once per turn, before the roll. Each foretold roll can be used once; unused ones are lost at your next Long Rest.

feature.name: Expert Divination
feature.summary: Casting a level 2+ Divination spell with a slot refunds a lower-level slot (level 5 or lower).
feature.text: When you cast a Divination spell of level 2 or higher with a spell slot, you regain one expended spell slot of a lower level than the one you used, and no higher than level 5.

feature.name: The Third Eye
feature.summary: Bonus Action: darkvision 120 ft, See Invisibility, read any language or see the Invisible nearby.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action, choose one benefit that lasts until you start a Short or Long Rest: Darkvision out to 120 feet; Greater Comprehension, letting you read any language; or See Invisibility, which you can cast without a spell slot. You can't use this feature again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
